GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out Not Bustled Settled Down 4th 4 Lengths off leader/winner within 3 Lengths @ 500m, Under Pressure Straightening Up Weakened to the line - # battled
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in on jumping and bumped. Rdr reported his mnt travelled satisfactorily through the early and middle stages, however he could not explain its failure to close off in the home straight. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Little Slow Out Ridden Along but Straight Out The Back Settled Down Clear last 10 Lengths Good Pace on, never trav well, tacked on @ 100m Kept Coming Closest - # couldn't go early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned re riding in the home straight, rdr std her mnt, which failed to display any early speed and trailed the field, was inclined to hang in through the early and middle stages. Std on entering the home straight she therefore pulled her whip through to the right hand and was able to place the mare under some pressure. She further added the mare continued to hang in and prove difficult to ride and after passing the 100m she was required to abruptly direct it out, whereby the mare changed lead leg and responded to her riding from that point.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast Went Forward from Outside Settled Down 3 Wide 5th 3 Lengths off leader/winner Out On A Limb To The Turn Hard Ridden , lay out Under Pressure Weakened to the line - # 3 wide, caved in
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout. Hung out rounding the home turn and when under pressure in the home straight. Rdr reported whilst noting the filly’s racing manners where mnt was inclined to hang out, it did not stretch out when under pressure in the home straight and, in his view, may appreciate a track with more give. A post-race vet exam did not reveal any abs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Ridden Along Went Forward from Outside Settled Down = Lead 3 Wide in Two Wide x 500m Beaten off Straightening Up - # faced breeze
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid out rounding the home turn. A post-race vet exam did not reveal any abs.
